summary: Frontend verification of hero full-bleed video and downstream page. Hero <video data-testid=hero-collage> covers the hero-section exactly (bounding boxes equal at 1440/1280/905/600/390), autoplays muted+loop (paused=false, currentTime advances 1.0->3.2 over 2s), currentSrc resolves to /hero-video.webm, poster=/hero-poster.jpg, no media error, readyState=4. Title 'Exquisitely crafted luxury honeymoons and holidays' renders white in 2 lines at 1440/1280/905/600 and 3 lines at 390 (acceptable narrow-mobile wrap). Subtitle visible at >=600px and hidden at 390px. Hero heights: 680 (1440/1280), 620 (905), 600 (600), 560 (390) - within spec (~680 at 1440, ~560 at 390). Trust-bar top exactly matches hero bottom (no gap). All required sections present (features-section, ambassadors-section, comparison-section, moments-section, steps-section, showcase-section, adventure-section, experts-section, testimonials-section, destinations-section, newsletter-section, site-footer). No console errors. No horizontal overflow at 390. Search submit does not navigate (URL unchanged). Showcase tab (canada->iceland) and destinations tab (top10->africa) switch content. Newsletter success message 'Thank you! Please check your inbox to confirm your subscription.' displays after submit.
critical_code_review_comments: Note: The task spec mentioned section testids like 'features','ambassadors', etc.; actual implementation uses '-section' suffix (features-section, etc.). Not a bug, but keep spec/testids consistent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Section data-testids use '-section' suffix (features-section, ambassadors-section, etc.). Hero video is a proper <video> tag with two <source> children (webm+mp4); in headless Chromium webm is selected. All acceptance criteria for iteration 4 verified passing.
